title: Shared model catalog refresh
implementation: Reuse one shared catalog refresh for model selector, Profiles, settings, schedules and existing consumers; retain cached candidates while refreshing and surface recoverable failures.
acceptance: All actual consumers observe refreshed data without clearing usable candidates, blocking input or creating agents. Unknown persisted provider/model/role/thinking values remain intact and visibly unresolved rather than being erased or silently replaced. Refresh keys include host, provider and cwd; late responses after any identity change cannot overwrite the current selection or catalog. Concurrent refresh, stale response, unknown-value preservation and failure/retry tests pass.

required: affected fmt/clippy/build/tests and runtime smoke for changed backend
affected SDK/UI/protocol checks and documented old-host/client downgrade

platform_limits: Actual browser web/native fixture smoke, not a physical Android/iOS or packaged Electron claim. No Rust source changes, therefore no Rust tests or clippy reruns.
